title: Emerald Isle 701
meta_description: Emerald Isle 701: Gulf-front 2BR condo with balcony, pools, hot tub, beach service, and gym. Walk to the beach and nearby Panama City attractions.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: This comfortable end unit condo with beautiful sunset views of the gulf has been remodeled, creating an idyllic setting for an unforgettable vacation! This condo can sleep up to 6 thanks to a plush new king size bed in the master, a queen bed in the guest bedroom, and a queen sofa sleeper in the living room. The master bedroom and the living room open onto your spacious balcony where the view of the ocean is stunning. The master bath has a newly renovated shower with glass enclosure and there is an additional full guest bathroom with a newly renovated tub/shower that is connected to the guest bedroom. Gulf front views from the large and spacious living/dining/kitchen area are fabulous through the floor-to-ceiling windows leading out to the large balcony.

Beach toys provided in the owners closet to help make your beach vacation simple and fun.

\*\*\* Gulf Front Condo - 7th Floor
\*\*\* Complimentary Beach Service (2 chairs, 1 umbrella - March thru October)

There is a fully equipped kitchen with all utensils, dishes, pots and pans you would need if you want to stay in and cook. The condo also has a washer and dryer.

ABOUT THE AREA: Emerald Isle has 2 large gulf front pools one of which indoor and outdoor and it is seasonally heated in addition to a large hot tub. The gym offers views of the gulf as far as the eye can see with sauna for a perfect end to your workout. You can also find an onsite pavilion with BBQ grills. Whether it's strolling on the beach, snorkeling, parasailing, or fishing, close by you'll find opportunities to enjoy everything there is to do in, under, above, or on the water.
Pier Park, the hottest spot in Panama City Beach is literally 3 miles away. Pier Park boasts unique dining, entertainment, and shopping experiences to name a few Jimmy Buffets Margaritaville, Tootsie's Orchid lounge, Dave and Busters, Miracle Strip and national and local retail merchants.

BEACH ACCESS: Head to the ground floor to access the beautiful emerald coast. Check in with the Beach Service Hut to get your complimentary beach chairs and umbrella set up.

Immerse yourself in the vibrant charm of Emerald Isle Resort in PCB!
Secure your spot for the ultimate beach getaway at Emerald Isle, nestled along the pristine white shores of Northwest Florida, promising a delightful Southern experience. Enhance your stay with the numerous community amenities that Emerald Isle has to offer. Answer the call of the beautiful beach view and venture downstairs to discover two Gulf-front pools for blissful lounging, a hot tub to soak away stress, and an on-site fitness room for those seeking an invigorating workout. Unite with fellow guests at the pool pavilion, where you can showcase your culinary skills on two stainless steel grills for a delightful cookout.
Don't forget to venture out and explore the nearby attractions during your stay in Panama City Beach. With a prime location along the shore, you're just moments away from exciting activities, including the renowned Gulf World Marine Park. Pier Park, the area's premier shopping, dining, and entertainment center, is also conveniently nearby. Countless opportunities for fun await throughout Panama City Beach, ensuring your stay at Emerald Isle is filled with joyful and unforgettable moments.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King Master with Ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- Queen Bed
• Queen Sleeper Sofa in living room

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Gulf front -- hear the waves from condo
• Complimentary Beach Service (includes 1 umbrella \& 2 chairs -- additional chairs can be rented from Beach Service Hut)
• 2 Community Pools (1 heated)
• Community Hot Tub
• Gym/Fitness Center with sauna and steam room
• Onsite Pavilion with BBQ grills
• Washer \& Dryer in unit
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Self-Check-In
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes

Enjoy an exclusive invitation with your booking to seasonal bonfires on the beach! Book your stay today!

\*\*HOA REQUIRED FEE: Upon arrival parking and pool passes must be purchased at the main office located on the 4th floor and must be displayed at all times. Passes are $40 per space for the duration of your stay.\*\*

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this home.

Parking Details:
- Guests enjoy secure covered parking in the parking garage below the units or an adjacent covered overflow parking with a covered walkway to the 3rd floor, with access to four large modern elevators.
- Please note only one parking space provided between Memorial Day and Labor Day.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
